req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. The view_status_code handler splits on commas, builds a weighted_choice list, and returns status_code(code). Tests must: (1) verify a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes (positive/EP), (2) verify an invalid code in the list returns 400 (negative/NEG), (3) verify a single-element list (boundary between comma and non-comma path, BVA), (4) verify weighted codes are accepted and return one of the listed codes (DT), (5) verify that all codes in the list are reachable over many trials (mutation-resilient probabilistic coverage), and (6) verify that a code NOT in the list is never returned (exact-value assertion). The random selection means we must run multiple trials to assert that the returned code is always a member of the input set and never outside it.

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
allowed = {200, 301, 404}
observed = set()
for _ in range(50):
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404')
    assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected status {r.status_code} not in {allowed}'
    observed.add(r.status_code)
assert len(observed) >= 1

def test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes_positive():
    client2 = app.test_client()
    allowed2 = {200, 301, 404}
    observed2 = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        r = client2.get('/status/200,301,404')
        assert r.status_code in allowed2, f'Got {r.status_code}'
        observed2.add(r.status_code)
    assert len(observed2) >= 1

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_weighted_comma_list_returns_only_listed_codes():
    client = app.test_client()
    allowed = {200, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(60):
        r = client.get('/status/200:3,500:1')
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Got unexpected {r.status_code}'
        observed.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in observed, '200 never observed in 60 trials'
    assert 500 in observed, '500 never observed in 60 trials'

302, 404, 201 are never returned

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_three_code_list_never_returns_unlisted_code():
    client = app.test_client()
    allowed = {200, 301, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(60):
        r = client.get('/status/200,301,500')
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected {r.status_code}'
        observed.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in observed, '200 never seen'
    assert 301 in observed, '301 never seen'
    assert 500 in observed, '500 never seen'
    assert observed == {200, 301, 500}, f'Extra codes observed: {observed}'
